summary: A new background pass can fold two open notes that ask the same question into one; it ships off, and runs first in a shadow mode that only records what it would fold.
details: [notes] merge_mode = "shadow" reads each unit's open notes side by side whenever one was written or added to, and records every fold it would make, with both titles and its reason, for the operator to review. No note changes.
In "on", the duplicate's question is appended to the oldest note of the group, which takes the later date, and the duplicate is retired and forwards to it; nothing is deleted.
A reminder Nora scheduled about a note that was folded now follows the note it went into instead of being cancelled.
The retire pass no longer retires a note that was folded into between its read and its write.
limitations: Off by default. "on" waits for an evaluation with operator-labelled near misses (design 41 §7.8).
Only notes born in the same room are folded.
